dataList.content:
So, how do we know this guy’s actually Distorted?
但是这个人，真的扭曲了吗？
dataList.place:
Lobotomy Corp. Branch, Past?
过去，脑叶公司支部？

dataList.content:
He doesn’t sound any different from his usual self…
听他说话的语气，和平常好像没什么差别……

The sanity degradation due to Distortion affects every subject differently.
扭曲对理性的影响根据人的不同，差异也会千差万别。

I mean, yeah, but… censoring his own Fathoms…?
真是，不管怎么说到处审查也有点……

But... Hohenheim, you’re in a Dungeon of the Fathoms.
但是……霍恩海姆先生，这里是心象迷宫。

We will see through it with Dante’s powers, whether you want to show us or not.
即使您不想给我们看，最后我们也会凭借但丁经理的能力看到。

<color=#ffffa1>You make a fair assessment.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>合理的意见。</color>

<color=#ffffa1>How about this, then?</color>
<color=#ffffa1>那么，这样如何？</color>

<color=#ffffa1>If you are to see them anyway, allow me to save you the trouble and give you a quick run-down instead. Come visit me as soon as you finish watching my tale.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>既然难以避免，不如简短地给你们看好了。看完了就立刻来见我。</color>

<color=#ffffa1>This tale began when that man walked into my laboratory.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>这个故事，是从那人进入我的研究室开始的。</color>

<color=#ffffa1>Yes, I had a personal laboratory all to myself. One of the few perks of being an elite researcher.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>对，我被分配了个人研究室。那是只有精英研究员才能拥有的为数不多的特权之一。</color>

... This guy’s just telling the story however he wants to, isn’t he?
……真的在擅自推动话题啊。

…eim.
……先生。
dataList.place:
Hohenheim's Laboratory, Past
过去，霍恩海姆的研究室

dataList.content:
Mr. Hohenheim.
霍恩海姆先生。

<color=#ffffa1>Let me think… I don’t quite remember what he looked like.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>那么，这人带着什么表情来着。</color>

<color=#ffffa1>Something like this, perhaps?</color>
<color=#ffffa1>我记得应该是这样吧。</color>

<color=#ffffa1>Ah, whichever is the case—I was planning to censor his appearance anyway.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>算了，怎么样都行。按照原计划进行审查就好。</color>

Ey, I wanted to talk to you about something.
我有些话想跟你说。

Stop. Are you here to express your displeasure with me?
等等，你难道是过来对我发火的吗？

The what now?
什么？

If you are, do let me know from the get-go. I had a feeling it was about time this would happen. 3 months—not a bad record for working without a workplace conflict.
想发火的话就先说。我已经预料到了。保持了3个月也算是不错的记录了。能在工作里不和任何人产生冲突。

Oh, if this is about quitting, then you would find a much better audience among the Human Resources team.
啊，如果想辞职的话比起我还是和人事部说会比较顺利。

No, I mean…
不是，我不是那意思……

I’m just here to thank ya.
我只是想来道谢。

For picking me, some dude from the Backstreets, to work here. I heard it was you who made the hiring decision.
我听说是你录用了后巷出身的我。

I dunno how to put this, but—you’re the only one who saw my, what's the word… yeah, my potentiality. You saw something that no one’s cared to look into before, know what I mean?
怎么说呢，那不就代表你看到了我的可能性吗。至今为止都没有一个人发现过。

<color=#ffffa1>Ah, but it had nothing to do with something so grandiose like his ‘potentiality’.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>当然，肯定不是因为可能性之类的宏大理由。</color>

<color=#ffffa1>A Wing does not hire people from the Backstreets for something so insignificant.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>堂堂一翼不可能因为那种理由录用后巷出身的人。</color>

<color=#ffffa1>While this information has never been publicly available, Lobotomy Corporation's primary criterion was ‘trauma’.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>虽然不为外人所知，但脑叶公司的选择标准实际上是“创伤”。</color>

<color=#ffffa1>Candidates with horrible, insurmountable trauma were often favored by the company.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>拥有越是可怖且难以克服的心理创伤的人，优先顺序就越高。</color>

<color=#ffffa1>And, in an indirect way, it was only natural that they would begin to favor candidates who originate from the Backstreets.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>因此后巷出身的比例也就自然而然地增多了。</color>

… Your greetings are acknowledged, Jimmy. Now, feel free to leave my office.
……我收到你的感谢了，吉米。你可以走了。

I ain't Jimmy.
不过我不叫吉米诶。

Anyways, I’ve been meaning to ask, Mr. Hohenheim… why do ya always enjoy being alone?
说来，为什么霍恩海姆先生总喜欢一个人待着？

It may come as a surprise to you, but I am very adept at spending my time all on my own. It is one of the hundreds of distinguishing features that set me apart from ordinary men.
你可能会感到惊讶，但我很享受一个人待着的时间。这只是和常人相异的数百个不同之处的其中之一。

Say, don’tcha need someone to be like, your loyal right-hand man?
那么啊，那个……你需不需要一个能言听计从的“右臂”呢？

My right hand is doing just fine, thank you very much.
我的右臂可还是好好的……

Do you believe in potentialities, Hohenheim?
霍恩海姆先生，你相信可能性吗？

<color=#ffffa1>Hm. What an unrelentingly stubborn employee he was, even in hindsight.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>这么一看，他真是个不听人话的员工啊。</color>

Thanks to you, I do. And I’ve been thinkin’... if I keep at it, one day I might even find myself living it large in a Nest. Changing’ my world little by little.
正因为你我才会相信。所以才会这么思考。“只要这么继续努力下去，总有一天我也能去巢里吧？”什么的。就这么一点点地改变围绕着我的世界。

Kinda like how a thing like me managed to snag a position here at Lobotomy Corporation.
正如我能入职脑叶公司一样。

So, I’m thinkin’ here… that I wanna stick around in your circle.
所以，我想在你身边再待一会儿。

To bring about such drastic changes to one's life is in the realm of feasibility for an exceptional researcher like myself, indeed. But you are, like most of the rabble, painfully average in most qualities and therefore unlikely to be the moving force in that change.
像我这样有才的研究员自然拥有可能性，但像你一样各项能力值都停留于平庸的人能够成功的概率应该极其低微。

I have no faith in universal things like ‘potentialities’; I have faith in myself and myself alone. Besides, I am not very partial to mathematical statistics like the probability theory anyway.
比起普遍的可能性，我只相信自己。而且概率论之类的数理统计学是我最讨厌的领域。

So, I would like to keep both my right and left hands as my own. Have a nice day.
所以不论是左膀还是右臂都还是我自己管理为好。辛苦你了。

… Wanna know something about me?
……你知道吗？

I’m the kind of guy who doesn’t really ‘think’ about things. Action before deliberation, ya get me?
我啊，就是不深思直接突进的类型。

Ah, thoughtless and carefree. Possibly the only merit to be found in those who originate from the Backstreets.
毕竟不加思考的自由奔放，是后巷出身之人唯一的特长。

… Or was that a thinly veiled threat of physical assault?
……又或者，你是想通过暴力行为来胁迫我？

No, I’m talkin’ about the new Abno that just got shipped here.
不，我说的是这次新移交来的异想体的事。

It's a tricky one to manage, I'll tell ya what. It reads your mind, screwin' up all kinds of strategies or whatever as long as it's based on hard logic.
那个的管理方法稍微有点特别。它能读取对方的心，不管是理论的作战还是其他的都毫无用处。

Wanna shoot for the Department of the Year award… together?
要不要一起瞄准……今年的最优秀部门奖？

… You seem to be rather skilled in the art of transactions.
你，还挺擅长交涉的。

One of the few merits found in those who originate from the Backstreets.
这是后巷出身的我唯一的长处。

<color=#ffffa1>I will admit, I suppose I was overcome by a certain ennui back then.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>对啊，承认吧。那时候的我有些无聊。</color>

<color=#ffffa1>And in hindsight, it was foolish of me to engage in such inane conversations.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>回头想想，进行那种毫无意义的对话并不是什么好选择。</color>

dataList.content:
… You… …le…
……你……我们……

… us…
……弃了……

<color=#ffffa1>Ah, the remnants of my past come to haunt us.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>哎呀，我过去的产物们似乎发起攻击了。</color>

<color=#ffffa1>Perhaps it is I whom they truly wish to hurt.</color>
<color=#ffffa1>或许，真正加害于他们的人是我吧。</color>
